title: Building a Corpus from Files and APIs
text: data already tabular – manual tracker, institutional export, spreadsheet works – robust entry point sm_corpus_from_tables(). validates required columns, coerces types, fills missing optional tables correctly-typed 0-row tibbles, returns ready sm_corpus, side-stepping format-specific parsers entirely. works-corpus perfectly valid: can pass works, authorships, sources, institutions, references, concepts, etc. named list elements.
code: works <- data.frame(   work_id = paste0("W", 1:3),   title = c("Spatial transcriptomics in cancer",             "Immune checkpoint resistance",             "A biomarker discovery cohort"),   year = c("2019", "2020", "2021"),   # character -> coerced to integer   doi = paste0("10.1234/example.", 1:3),   cited_by_count = c(12, 5, 1) ) corpus <- sm_corpus_from_tables(list(works = works)) #> ℹ works: coerced column year and cited_by_count to the schema type. #> ℹ works: filled missing column abstract, type, source_id, oa_status, language, #>   pmid, arxiv_id, openalex_id, is_retracted, retraction_date, and #>   last_refreshed with typed `NA`. corpus #>  #> ── <sm_corpus> ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> Works: 3 | Authors: 0 | Institutions: 0 #> Years: 2019 - 2021 #> Sources (journals): 0 #> Embeddings: none #> Status: Unlocked (last refreshed: never)

title: Building a Corpus from Files and APIs

title: Build an author trajectory analysis — sm_author_trajectory
text: Analyses career trajectory single author within corpus, partitioning publication record n_periods career stages. period, function computes: Career stages: dominant topics publication volume. Topic pivots: much research focus shifted periods, measured Jaccard distance concept sets. Collaborator turnover: Jaccard similarity co-author sets across consecutive periods, plus counts new, kept, lost collaborators. Emerging collaborators: co-authors first appear recent period. H-index curve: cumulative h-index end period. Novelty curve: average concept novelty per period. Citation acceleration: mean citations per period relative corpus-wide mean years.

text: tibble columns work_id cd_index. CD index ranges -1 (consolidating) +1 (disruptive). Works without sufficient citation data receive NA.

title: Calculate the CD (disruption) index — sm_metric_disruption
text: CD index defined : $$CD = \frac{n_i - n_j}{n_i + n_j + n_k}$$ focal work f: n_i Number works cite f cite f's references (disruptive citations). n_j Number works cite f least one f's references (consolidating citations). n_k Number works cite least one f's references cite f (ignored--referencing citations). CD index near +1 indicates focal work highly disruptive: citers tend ignore references. CD index near -1 indicates focal work consolidates existing ideas.

text: reported real corpus; now regression test reproducing recurrence.
